title: The Commander of Time
html:
The Commander of Time

Quest Type

Main

Chapter

Chapter I: Act VII - Thaw of Eons

Description

It is the deity that commands time. It is the deity that bestows blessings. Now is your time to confront Sentinel Jué.

Steps[]

  1. Leave Mianloong Chamber
  2. Confront the Sentinel "Jué"
  3. Leave the Temporal Loop

Dialogue[]

Quest Description
It is the deity that commands time. It is the deity that bestows blessings. Now is your time to confront Sentinel Jué.
(When player leaves the area)
(Cutscene starts)
"Jué": (‍‍LordText for male Rover‍/‍LadyText for female Rover‍‍) Arbiter, one is curious about your choice this time.
"Jué": Wherever the tides may take us, you will bear witness to our fight.
Xinyi: Government must be guided by virtue. Hsi, do you keep this in mind?
Jinhsi: Yes, virtue must come first. Politics, commerce—it all must serve the people.
"Jué": From now on, you shall be known as "Jinhsi," bearing Jinzhou's name as your own.
"Jué": What do you think of this world?
Jinhsi: Like... here. Darkness clings, but lights flicker in the gloom...
"Jué": A guiding light is not easily lit.
Jinhsi: That's why they stand out so brightly against the darkness.
(Cutscene ends)
"Jué": This entrance leads to one's Sonoro Sphere. Magistrate Jinhsi, one shall await you there.
"Jué": (‍RoverThe player's chosen name for Rover‍), this battle is related to the fate of Jinzhou, and only you can open this Sonoro Sphere. The key to Jinzhou's future lies in your hands.
Rover: ...If I open it, Jinhsi is bound to face you in the ultimate battle.
Rover: The ideal outcome would be for her to absorb your power at the critical moment and restore the time flow without any loss of life.
Rover: But there's also a chance that she could push herself too far and end up dying from Overclocking.
Rover: Though... if I do nothing, you'll use your remaining power to freeze all of Jinzhou in time.
"Jué": Correct.
"Jué": Now, please let us know your choice.
Jinhsi: (‍RoverThe player's chosen name for Rover‍)...
I will open the entrance once you're ready.
Jinhsi: I have been preparing for this moment.
There will be no turning back...
Jinhsi: I understand. I have made up my mind since before I stepped foot on Mt. Firmament.
Jinhsi: Leaving Jinzhou behind fills me with regret, knowing I may never again bask in its glorious sunshine or witness the purity of its snowflakes.
Jinhsi: But that's why I'm here—to ensure that others can still experience the wonders of nature.
Jinhsi: Our city has a rich history, with generations witnessing endless sunrises and sunsets at the border. Our people have sacrificed their blood and tears to protect Huanglong's safety.
Jinhsi: They deserve a bright future.
Jinhsi: I want to protect Jinzhou in my own way, as Jinhsi, as a citizen of Jinzhou, and as Jinzhou's Magistrate.
Jinhsi: (‍RoverThe player's chosen name for Rover‍), let's begin.
(Cutscene plays)
(Cutscene ends)
"Jué": Quite the impressive feat, Magistrate Jinhsi.
"Jué": However, you are still a long way from inheriting my power.
"Jué": Back down now while you still can.
Jinhsi: I have made up my mind, and I will not back down.
Jinhsi: You once said it's not easy to become a candle of light...
Jinhsi: But I still want to try. I want to see if I can ignite a spark of hope for Jinzhou!
(Cutscene plays)
"Jué": (‍‍LordText for male Rover‍/‍LadyText for female Rover‍‍) Arbiter, may this one transfer the Temporal Mandate to Jinhsi?
"Jué": This one has heard your decision.
"Jué": The transfer has been carried out as you instructed.
"Jué": Jinhsi, one shall honor one's promise and restore Jinzhou's future to you and its people.
(Cutscene ends)
"Jué": Jinhsi has recovered. One will soon send her back to Jinzhou for recuperation. Please do not worry.
"Jué": With all matters resolved, as per the agreement, it is time for one to address you.
"Jué": One is prepared to answer any inquiries you may have.
(Ask about your past.)
"Jué": I am Jué the Sentinel, the guide of Jinzhou's civilization. Everything about Jinzhou has been stored in my mind.
"Jué": You, (‍RoverThe player's chosen name for Rover‍), are my Arbiter, and my former master.
"Jué": In bygone days, I stood by your side as you established the Jinzhou city. You tasked me with safeguarding its prosperity.
So why did I lose my memories?
Who am I?
"Jué": This one begs your pardon, for it is not all-knowing. All my knowledge came from you.
"Jué": One is prepared to answer any inquiries you may have.
(Ask about the "choice" and the "access".)
"Jué": In the past, one was granted the key to that Sonoro Sphere by your hand.
"Jué": You said you planned to participate in history, to make choices and witness the development of civilizations.
"Jué": One had previously requested for permission to transfer the Temporal Mandate to Jinhsi, as that is how one is designed to function.
"Jué": Every ounce of my existence, from life to death and even the passing on of power, is subject to your approval.
"Jué": One is prepared to answer any inquiries you may have.
(Ask about Jinhsi's condition.)
"Jué": Since Jinhsi has inherited my power, the Temporal Programs are now complete. Jinzhou is no longer under threat.
"Jué": Jinhsi has fully assumed the mantle of leadership. From this day forth, one shall only offer aid when it is truly needed.
Why didn't you tell Jinhsi about it eariler?
"Jué": This situation has been analyzed before, but the number of variables made reaching a safe conclusion impossible.
"Jué": To accomplish her goal, Jinhsi must possess both strength and confidence. Revealing the truth to her earlier would only add to her troubles and not aid in improving her abilities.
"Jué": Today was not the ideal moment for our destined battle to unfold, but the Fractsidus has remarkably escalated its arrival.
"Jué": One is prepared to answer any inquiries you may have.
(Ask about the current situation in Hongzhen.)
"Jué": The flow of time on Mt. Firmament has been restored to its natural pace, but the citizens of Hongzhen must still contend with shortened lifespans should they attempt to depart.
"Jué": Fortunately, with Jinhsi's Resonance Ability, they can stay safe as long as they remain on the mountain.
"Jué": For lack of a better solution, this is the best we can do.
"Jué": Through countless ages, the imposing Mt. Firmament stood firm against the storms. But as spring brings thunder and change, one feels a spark of transformation in the air.
"Jué": One is prepared to answer any inquiries you may have.
I have no other questions.
"Jué": The people of Hongzhen have a bright future ahead, one that can be steered in the right direction within mere days. With proper leadership.
"Jué": Your Tacet Mark... There is something unusual.
You mean Abby?
Abby, wake up. Someone's asking about you.
Abby: Whoa... What... What's wrong?!
Abby: (‍RoverThe player's chosen name for Rover‍), who's bullying you?!
Abby: Is it you, big thing?! Huh?! How dare you, I'm gonna teach you a le...
Abby: Hmm? Wait, pause... I don't think it has any bad intentions... It smells like the "unnatural" smell I smelled in Jinzhou before...
Well, about the Sentinel I was looking for...
Abby: Ooh, so you must be that Sentinel! Hehe, hello there big one!
Abby: (‍RoverThe player's chosen name for Rover‍), why didn't you wake me up earlier? I've got a feeling I missed out on a lot of fun!
"Jué": ...It does feel similar to me, but there is some difference.
Do you know what it is?
"Jué": ...This entity is unfamiliar to me. As it resides within your Tacet Mark, one can only assume you granted it access intentionally.
Then who else can answer my questions?
"Jué": (‍‍LordText for male Rover‍/‍LadyText for female Rover‍‍) Arbiter, have you heard of the Black Shores?
The Black Shores? I've heard of them.
Yeah, I know those people.
"Jué": The Black Shores is the starting point of your journey in this world. If you have doubts, this one suggests a visit to that island.
I'll keep it in mind.
"Jué": Worry not.
"Jué": The wuthering waves ebb and flow. They shall send you back to where you belong.
